description: Which of the account's recordings said something, and when. Looks for the words as one phrase in what was said (not in titles), in the newest 500 recordings (ones still processing or failed among them are skipped; truncated is true when there may be older ones, which are not read): give a distinctive word or short phrase, not a question. Each result has up to five matches with the second each starts at; read around one with get_transcript's from and to rather than reading the whole transcript.
name: search_transcriptions
title: Search transcriptions
